university-of-hong-kong.about:
Founded in 1911, HKU is a comprehensive research university on Hong Kong Island with ten faculties, strong professional schools (medicine, law, dentistry, architecture) and an English-medium curriculum built around a common core. It recruits heavily from mainland China, Asia and beyond, and its graduates are well placed for careers in finance, law and research across Asia.

Non-local applicants with IB, A-levels, US high-school diplomas (with SAT/ACT/AP) or other national qualifications apply through HKU's own online system. Submitting by the late-November first-round date gives the earliest decisions; later applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Fees are high for non-locals, so check the merit entrance scholarships early.
university-of-hong-kong.tests: SAT/ACT and AP are accepted as part of US-curriculum qualifications; IB, A-level and many national diplomas accepted. Applicants whose school language is not English must meet HKU's English language requirement (IELTS/TOEFL and others; see the official page).
university-of-hong-kong.aid_intl: Entrance scholarships for non-local students are awarded on merit through the HKU Scholarships Office (the admissions site lists dozens matching non-local applicants); no need-blind aid for international students.

chinese-university-of-hong-kong.about:
CUHK, founded in 1963, is a comprehensive research university with nine colleges that give students a smaller residential community within a large campus. It is especially strong in medicine, business, engineering, translation and journalism, and most undergraduate programmes are taught in English or bilingually.

Non-local applicants with IB, A-levels, US diplomas plus SAT/ACT, or other national qualifications apply through CUHK's own portal. Applying in the Advance Offer Round (by 12 November) brings decisions from December; everyone else competes in the Regular Round (deadline 7 January). Successful applicants pay a HK$10,000 first instalment to accept their place.
chinese-university-of-hong-kong.tests: Minimum SAT 1190 / ACT 24 for US-pattern applicants (plus AP tests). English: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before 21 Jan 2026; 4.5/6 on the new TOEFL scale), or SAT EBRW 590 / ACT ELA 23. IELTS Online, One Skill Retake and TOEFL Home Edition are not accepted.
chinese-university-of-hong-kong.aid_intl: Admission scholarships (merit-based) are open to non-local undergraduates; CUHK also runs financial aid schemes. Details on the Scholarships page.

hkust.about:
HKUST opened in 1991 and rose quickly into the world top 50 on the strength of its engineering, science and business schools. Teaching is in English, the campus is residential, and there are interdisciplinary options such as the Technology and Management dual degree and an Individualized Interdisciplinary Major.

Non-local applicants submit one online application with a personal statement, school reports from Grade 10, proof of English and an academic referee. Applying by the Priority Round (25 November) gives the earliest offers; the system stays open until June on a rolling basis.
hkust.tests: SAT, ACT and AP are accepted with US-curriculum diplomas. English proof required: IELTS Academic, TOEFL, Duolingo, PTE and others are accepted (minimums shown per test on the International Qualifications page). Application fee HK$600.
hkust.aid_intl: Admission scholarships are considered automatically (University Admissions Scholarship for Other Qualifications, Global Learners Scholarship, Olympiad Medalist scheme); the Future Leaders Award and Beyond Academic Admissions Scholarship need a separate application.

shanghai-jiao-tong-university.about:
Founded in 1896, SJTU is a leading Chinese research university with particular strength in engineering, medicine and naval architecture. International undergraduates can study engineering entirely in English through the Global College, which grew out of the University of Michigan-SJTU Joint Institute, with majors such as mechanical, electrical and computer engineering and civil engineering.

Applicants submit the new CSCA maths test plus SAT/ACT, A-level or IB results, an English test, two recommendations, transcripts and a RMB 100,000 financial guarantee. Strong applicants can win scholarships ranging from 25% tuition to a full four-year package with monthly living and housing allowances.
shanghai-jiao-tong-university.tests: CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) with Mathematics is required; SAT (code 6563) or ACT (6983), A-level (Maths A) or IB (Maths HL 5) support the application. 2026 admits' middle 50%: SAT 1390-1500, ACT 30-34. English: TOEFL iBT 90 (or 4.5 on the new scale), IELTS 6.0 or Duolingo 120; exemptions for SAT EBRW 650+ or ACT Reading and English 27+.
shanghai-jiao-tong-university.aid_intl: Shanghai Government and SJTU scholarships are applied for on the SJTU form: First-Class (4-year full tuition waiver + RMB 2,500/month living allowance + RMB 1,100/month housing subsidy + insurance), Second-Class (50% tuition + housing subsidy), Third-Class (25% tuition). Chinese Government (CSC) Scholarship via Chinese embassies.

university-of-tokyo.about:
The University of Tokyo, founded in 1877, is Japan's leading research university. Its new UTokyo College of Design, taking its first students in September 2027, combines design approaches with knowledge from across UTokyo's disciplines to tackle complex social problems; teaching is in English, and students complete their whole degree within the college.

Route B is designed for international-curriculum students: you submit English-language documents, an accepted standardized test or qualification and an English test, and shortlisted applicants are interviewed online in English. The needs-based scholarship covers tuition and living costs (JPY 2.4 million a year) plus a flight, which makes this one of the most accessible ways into UTokyo for international students.
university-of-tokyo.tests: Two routes, 100 places (50 each). Route A: Japan's Common Test for University Admissions (January 2027, about 80%+ expected) plus an English test, then in-person screening. Route B: an accepted standardized test or qualification (e.g. IB, A-level, SAT/ACT and others listed by UTokyo) plus a designated English proficiency test, then an online interview in English.
university-of-tokyo.aid_intl: UTokyo Design Needs-based Scholarship (grant, open to all nationalities and both routes): JPY 2,400,000 per year for tuition and living costs, the admission fee in year one, and a one-way flight to Japan for overseas residents. Merit-based scholarships are awarded automatically in year one from admission results.

institut-polytechnique-de-paris.about:
Institut Polytechnique de Paris groups France’s leading engineering schools (École Polytechnique, ENSTA, ENSAE, Télécom Paris, Télécom SudParis). For undergraduates, the main English-taught entry is École Polytechnique’s Bachelor of Science: three years, fully in English, with double majors such as Mathematics & Computer Science, Mathematics & Economics and Mathematics & Physics, plus a BS/MS track with Columbia University and a Global Dual Degree in Engineering. Students live on the Palaiseau campus south of Paris.

Admission is holistic but demands very strong maths and science: you apply online with transcripts, a personal statement and two referees, and shortlisted candidates are interviewed online. There are three application rounds for 2027 entry, and financial aid (merit and need-based) is limited, so apply in an early round if you need support.
institut-polytechnique-de-paris.tests: No SAT/ACT required (scores can be reported if taken). English: TOEFL iBT 90 or IELTS 6.5 (min 6 per skill) or Cambridge C1/C2 176; results under two years old. No French required to apply (B2 French needed to graduate). Shortlisted candidates have a ~50-minute online interview.
institut-polytechnique-de-paris.aid_intl: Merit-based and need-based scholarships from the École Polytechnique Foundation (the two can be combined); aid is limited and usually does not cover full tuition.
institut-polytechnique-de-paris.gpa_note: Very strong overall academic average with advanced mathematics and at least one advanced science course; holistic review.

northwestern-university.about:
Northwestern's six undergraduate schools include the Medill School of Journalism, the McCormick School of Engineering, the School of Communication and the Bienen School of Music, alongside the Weinberg College of Arts and Sciences. Students apply to a specific school, can double-major across schools and use the quarter system to take many courses.

The Evanston campus sits on the lakefront 20 minutes from downtown Chicago, giving access to internships in finance, media and consulting. In fall 2025 the university admitted about 7.7% of 49,474 first-year applicants (Common Data Set).
northwestern-university.tests: Test-optional: SAT/ACT not required (scores may be submitted). English proficiency score required if English is not your first language or school language (TOEFL iBT, IELTS incl. Indicator, Duolingo); no minimum, but competitive applicants score in the high range.
northwestern-university.aid_intl: Need-aware for international applicants, but Northwestern meets 100% of demonstrated need for all admitted first-years for four years. Need-based aid only; no merit scholarships.
northwestern-university.gpa_note: Most admitted students rank in the top 10% of their class with the most rigorous curriculum available.

hong-kong-polytechnic-university.about:
PolyU in Hung Hom, Kowloon, is a large public university with a practical, industry-linked approach. Its School of Hotel and Tourism Management and School of Design are among the best known in Asia, and it also has strong engineering, rehabilitation sciences, nursing and accounting programmes, all taught in English.

Non-local students apply through the eAdmission system with IB, A-levels, SAT/AP or other recognised qualifications. Non-local first-year students are normally offered a hall place; from year two they arrange housing themselves, which matters for budgeting in Hong Kong.
hong-kong-polytechnic-university.tests: International qualifications (IB, A-level, SAT/AP, national diplomas) accepted; applicants from non-English-medium schools need an English test (see PolyU English requirements page).
hong-kong-polytechnic-university.aid_intl: Undergraduate entrance scholarships for non-local students are listed on the PolyU Fees and Scholarships pages.

national-taiwan-university.about:
NTU, founded in 1928, is Taiwan's leading comprehensive research university, with eleven colleges and close links to the island's semiconductor and technology industry. Many undergraduate courses are taught in Mandarin, though the university lists English-taught programmes and offers Chinese language study for international students.

International degree students apply online in rounds; the first round for September 2027 runs until 5 November 2026. Compare departments carefully, as language and document requirements differ, and look at Taiwan government scholarships alongside NTU's own awards.
national-taiwan-university.tests: Requirements vary by department; most undergraduate programmes teach in Mandarin, so Chinese proficiency (TOCFL) is often required, while English-taught programmes require English proof. Check each department's requirements in the application guidelines.
national-taiwan-university.aid_intl: NTU lists scholarship opportunities for international degree students on its admissions site; Taiwan government scholarships (e.g. MOE/ICDF) are applied for separately.

kaist.about:
KAIST was founded in 1971 as Korea's first research-oriented science and engineering institution and is now one of Asia's top technical universities. Freshmen enter without a declared major and choose any department at the end of their second semester, with no quota per major, which suits students who want to explore before specialising.

International applicants apply online in an Early round (autumn) or a Regular round (November to mid-January), submit school records, essays and a recommendation letter, and may be interviewed online. The KAIST Scholarship covers full tuition for eight semesters and KRW 350,000 a month, making it one of the most generous undergraduate offers in Asia.
kaist.tests: No SAT/ACT requirement is stated on the eligibility page. Proof of English (or Korean) proficiency is set out in the application guide. Applicants must hold foreign citizenship, and neither parent may be a Korean citizen (special rules apply to applicants of Korean origin).
kaist.aid_intl: Every admitted international undergraduate who ticks "KAIST scholarship" on the application receives full tuition exemption for 8 semesters plus KRW 350,000 a month for living costs (GPA of 2.7/4.3 must be kept after the first year). No separate scholarship application.

brown-university.about:
Brown's Open Curriculum has no distribution requirements: students choose from 80+ concentrations, may take any course pass/fail and often combine fields. The Program in Liberal Medical Education offers an eight-year BA/MD track, and a dual degree with the Rhode Island School of Design is available.

About 14% of Brown's students come from abroad. Admission is extremely selective, SAT/ACT scores are required again, and international applicants are reviewed need-blind.
brown-university.tests: SAT or ACT required (superscored; no minimum). English test highly recommended for non-native speakers; expected minimums: TOEFL 105 (before Jan 2026) or 5.5 (new scale), IELTS 8.0, Duolingo 130.
brown-university.aid_intl: Need-blind for international students (from the Class of 2029 onwards) and Brown meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students who apply for aid when they apply. Need-based only; no merit awards.

university-of-birmingham.about:
The University of Birmingham is a founding member of the Russell Group with a large green campus at Edgbaston and undergraduate programmes across arts, social sciences, law, business, engineering, life sciences and medicine. It also runs a Liberal Arts and Natural Sciences degree for students who want breadth.

Applications go through UCAS. Offers are set per course; for example Philosophy asks AAB or IB 32 with 6,6,5 at Higher Level. Applicants with a US high school diploma generally need a 3.2+ GPA plus APs, SAT or ACT. International fees vary by course and are fixed for the duration of study.
university-of-birmingham.tests: SAT/ACT used only for US-curriculum applicants (e.g. HSD with GPA 3.2+ plus APs/SAT/ACT; ACT 28 or SAT 670 can satisfy maths/English). English: typically IELTS 6.0–6.5 (no band below 5.5–6.0) depending on course; e.g. Philosophy BA needs IELTS 6.5 (6.0 per band) or TOEFL iBT 88 (pre-2026 scale) / 4.5 (new scale).
university-of-birmingham.aid_intl: Merit scholarships for internationals, e.g. High Fliers Undergraduate Scholarships (£5,000 off first-year tuition for students from selected countries); over £7.5m in international scholarships. US students can use Federal Direct Loans.
university-of-birmingham.gpa_note: Course-specific offers, e.g. Philosophy BA: AAB at A-level or IB 32 with 6,6,5 at HL; US HSD: unweighted GPA 3.2+ plus APs, SAT or ACT.

ut-austin.about:
UT Austin is one of the largest universities in the US, with 18 colleges and schools. Applicants choose a first and second-choice major; competitive programmes such as computer science, McCombs business and Cockrell engineering admit far fewer students than they receive. Austin is a fast-growing tech hub, which helps with internships.

International first-year applicants apply through ApplyTexas or the Common App, pay a USD 90 fee, submit an essay, SAT/ACT and an English test, and can add an optional short answer and up to two recommendation letters.
ut-austin.tests: SAT or ACT required (send at least one official score). English: TOEFL iBT 79 (or 4 on the new 6-point scale), IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, or Duolingo 115, unless exempt as a citizen of a sole-English-official-language country.
ut-austin.aid_intl: Limited: international students are not eligible for federal or Texas state aid. Some merit scholarships from colleges and departments; most internationals must show full funding for the I-20.

universite-paris-saclay.about:
Université Paris-Saclay brings together former Université Paris-Sud, several grandes écoles and national research labs on a large science campus south-west of Paris. It is known worldwide for mathematics (multiple Fields medallists) and physics, and offers Licence (bachelor) degrees across sciences, law, economics, sport and health.

First-year Licence courses are taught in French, so plan for B2–C1 French. Non-EU students who do not hold a French or European baccalaureate apply through Études en France (or a DAP file if their country is not covered) by mid-December; EU students use Parcoursup. Thanks to a partial exemption, non-EU students pay the same low national fee as French students.
universite-paris-saclay.tests: No SAT/ACT. Most undergraduate degrees are taught in French: B2–C1 French required (DAP: TCF or DELF/DALF B2, or TEF 400/699). No English test needed for French-taught Licences.
universite-paris-saclay.aid_intl: Very low tuition for everyone thanks to the fee exemption; individual fee waivers on social criteria. Few undergraduate scholarships for internationals.
universite-paris-saclay.gpa_note: Secondary diploma giving access to university in your country; selection on school record and French level.

university-of-leeds.about:
The University of Leeds is one of the UK’s largest universities, with a single city-centre campus and hundreds of undergraduate degrees across arts, business, engineering, environment, medicine and social sciences. Many courses offer an optional industrial placement or study-abroad year at a reduced fee.

Apply through UCAS by the January equal consideration date. Leeds sets the international fee per course and keeps it fixed for each year of study. Students from a long list of countries and regions receive an automatic £5,000 first-year scholarship.
university-of-leeds.tests: No SAT/ACT for most applicants (AP/SAT used in US-curriculum assessment). English: IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5 (some courses 6.5–7.0); TOEFL iBT 80 (old scale) or 4.0 (tests from 21 Jan 2026), taken at a test centre.
university-of-leeds.aid_intl: Up to £4.7m in international scholarships, including an automatic £5,000 International Undergraduate Regional Scholarship (first-year fee reduction) for passport holders of eligible countries/regions.
university-of-leeds.gpa_note: Offers are course-specific and listed on each Leeds course page (A-level, IB and international equivalents).

uc-san-diego.about:
UC San Diego organises undergraduates into eight residential colleges, each with its own general-education programme, inside a large research university that includes the Scripps Institution of Oceanography and a major medical school. It is especially known for biological sciences, bioengineering, cognitive science and computing.

Applicants choose a major (some, like computer science, are capped and very competitive). UC San Diego received 141,767 first-year applications for fall 2026 and admitted 27.2% (UC admit data).
uc-san-diego.tests: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.
uc-san-diego.aid_intl: International students are not eligible for US federal or California state need-based aid. Campus scholarships for international first-years are very limited; plan to fund the full cost.
uc-san-diego.gpa_note: Middle 50% weighted high-school GPA of fall 2026 admits: 4.12-4.28 (UC admit data).

kth-royal-institute-of-technology.about:
KTH is Sweden’s leading engineering school, with research and teaching across computer science, electrical and mechanical engineering, architecture and industrial management. Most undergraduate engineering degrees are taught in Swedish; international bachelor’s applicants usually target the English-taught BSc in Information and Communication Technology at the Kista campus, the hub of Stockholm’s tech industry.

You apply centrally through University Admissions in Sweden in Round 1 (deadline 15 January), uploading your school documents and English test by 1 February. Non-EU/EEA students pay tuition and a SEK 900 application fee, and KTH does not award scholarships at bachelor level, so budget carefully.
kth-royal-institute-of-technology.tests: No SAT/ACT. English 6 equivalent: IELTS Academic 6.5 (no section below 5.5) or TOEFL iBT 90 (writing 20). The programme also requires upper-secondary mathematics at an advanced level. Most other KTH bachelor’s degrees are taught in Swedish.
kth-royal-institute-of-technology.aid_intl: KTH offers no scholarships for its bachelor’s programme. Non-EU students may look at external funding only; Swedish Institute scholarships are for master’s level.
kth-royal-institute-of-technology.gpa_note: Completed upper-secondary education with advanced mathematics; selection by grades.

university-of-sheffield.about:
The University of Sheffield is a research-intensive Russell Group university with a large engineering faculty, strong architecture, journalism and medicine, and a students’ union that regularly wins national awards. The city is compact, affordable by UK standards and next to the Peak District.

Apply through UCAS. Offers depend on the course, for example Computer Science BSc asks AAA (or AAB with an A in Maths and B in Computer Science) or IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths. Overseas fees for 2027 entry range from £27,650 to £34,670, and eligible international students receive an automatic £2,500-a-year scholarship.
university-of-sheffield.tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: IELTS 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each component for most courses (or GCSE English grade 4/C); other equivalent qualifications listed by the university.
university-of-sheffield.aid_intl: International Undergraduate Scholarship 2027: £2,500 per year (up to £10,000), applied automatically as a fee discount to eligible overseas students who firm Sheffield by 2 June 2027 and keep a 60% average.
university-of-sheffield.gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. Computer Science BSc: AAA (or AAB with A in Maths, B in Computer Science), or IB 36 with 6 in HL Maths.

durham-university.about:
Durham is England’s third-oldest university and, like Oxford and Cambridge, collegiate: every student joins one of its colleges for accommodation, sport and community. It is highly selective, with strong English, history, law, philosophy and politics, and a flexible Natural Sciences degree.

Apply through UCAS by the January deadline. Offers are high, for example English Literature asks A*AA. International fees are set per course (English Literature £30,000 for 2027 entry) and rise each year. Self-funded international students who firm Durham can compete for Inspiring Excellence Scholarships worth £5,000 or £10,000 a year.
durham-university.tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: most courses Band B = IELTS 6.5 (no component under 6.0), TOEFL iBT 80 with no component under 20 (pre-2026 scale) or 4.5 on the new scale, Duolingo 120 (no sub-score under 110); Band A courses need IELTS 7.0 / Duolingo 130.
durham-university.aid_intl: Durham Inspiring Excellence Undergraduate Scholarships (2027 entry): competitive tuition discounts of £5,000 or £10,000 per year for self-funded international students who make Durham their UCAS firm choice and submit the scholarship form.

politecnico-di-milano.about:
Politecnico di Milano is a public university with around 49,000 students across schools of engineering, architecture, design and urban planning, with campuses in Milan and northern Italian cities such as Como, Cremona, Lecco, Mantua and Piacenza. It ranks among the world’s top 20 for engineering, architecture and art & design subjects.

Applicants with foreign qualifications apply online. For engineering you sit the TOL test or submit an accepted alternative such as the SAT; architecture and design have their own tests. Most bachelor’s degrees are taught in Italian, with a smaller set in English. Fees depend on family income and top out at about €3,943 a year.
politecnico-di-milano.tests: Engineering BSc entrance test: TOL (Polimi, in Italian), TOLC-I, English TOLC (CISIA) or the SAT (accepted as an alternative test). English-taught programmes require proof of English before enrolment (certificate, English-medium schooling or English-speaking citizenship); Italian-taught programmes require Italian proficiency.
politecnico-di-milano.aid_intl: Income-based DSU (Diritto allo Studio) scholarships with fee waiver and allowance; Polimi scholarships for international students on selected English-taught BSc programmes.
politecnico-di-milano.gpa_note: Secondary diploma valid for university access plus an entrance test score (TOL or accepted alternative such as SAT).

uppsala-university.about:
Uppsala University, founded in 1477, is a classic Scandinavian research university with strengths across the natural sciences, medicine, humanities and social sciences. For international bachelor’s students it offers nine English-taught programmes, most of them at Campus Gotland in the World Heritage town of Visby (for example Game Design and Programming, Energy Transition, Leadership – Quality Management – Improvement) and some in Uppsala (for example Theoretical Philosophy).

All applications go through universityadmissions.se by 15 January, with documents due 1 February. EU/EEA citizens study free; others pay tuition that varies by programme and a SEK 900 application fee.
uppsala-university.tests: No SAT/ACT. English level 2 / English 6 equivalent: IELTS Academic 6.5 (no section below 5.5) or TOEFL iBT 90 (writing 20). Some programmes add maths or other prerequisites.
uppsala-university.aid_intl: Non-EU students should look for external funding; Uppsala’s own tuition waivers and Swedish Institute scholarships are mainly for master’s level.
uppsala-university.gpa_note: General entry requirements for Swedish first-cycle studies (completed upper-secondary education), plus programme-specific prerequisites.

penn-state-university.about:
Penn State is a land-grant university with one of the largest alumni networks in the world. Students apply to a specific campus and major; University Park is the most competitive campus, while the Commonwealth campuses offer smaller classes and a '2+2' path to finish at University Park.

The Schreyer Honors College is a separate, selective honours programme with its own earlier application. International applicants must submit official transcripts with a marking key, proof of English, and financial documents for the I-20.
penn-state-university.tests: Test-optional: SAT/ACT not required (can be used to prove English). English proof for non-native speakers: Duolingo 120, TOEFL iBT 80 (before 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 (new scale), IELTS Academic 6.5; SAT EBRW 570 or ACT English 24 also accepted.
penn-state-university.aid_intl: Limited: international students are not eligible for US federal aid; some college and campus scholarships may be available. Expect to show full funding for the I-20.

university-of-washington.about:
The UW's Seattle campus is one of the largest research universities in the US, with the Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering, a leading medical school and strong programmes in oceanography and environmental science. Some majors, including computer science and engineering, admit students directly to the major, with lower admit rates.

The UW reviews applications holistically. Its 3-year average admit rate for non-Washington residents is 39% (37% for direct-to-college engineering). International students pay non-resident tuition and should plan to fund the full cost.

university-of-alberta.about:
The U of A has over 200 undergraduate programmes and about 8,000 international students from 156 countries. It is home to the Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute (Amii), making it a world centre for reinforcement learning and AI research, and is known for engineering and energy-related fields.

Applications open on 1 October and most programmes close on 1 March. Admission is based on grades in specific prerequisite subjects for your curriculum; scholarships are assessed automatically with your application or, for the big awards, via a separate application by 10 January.

university-of-alberta.aid_intl: Merit scholarships for international students: automatic International Admission Scholarship (up to CAD 10,000) and application-based awards such as the President's International Distinction Scholarship (up to CAD 120,000 over 4 years).

university-of-nottingham.about:
The University of Nottingham is a Russell Group university whose University Park campus is one of the greenest in the UK; computer science sits on the nearby Jubilee Campus. It has strong pharmacy, engineering, economics, law and medicine, a big sports programme, and sister campuses in Malaysia and Ningbo, China.

Apply through UCAS. Offers are course-specific; Computer Science BSc asks AAA (AAB including A in computer science) or IB 34, and IELTS 6.5 with no element below 6.0. International students who achieve AAA or equivalent receive an automatic £5,000 first-year scholarship.

university-of-nottingham.aid_intl: International Undergraduate Excellence Scholarship: an automatic £5,000 off first-year tuition for students who achieve AAA or the international equivalent; further undergraduate, sports and country scholarships.

freie-universitat-berlin.about:
Freie Universität Berlin was founded in 1948 in West Berlin and is a German “University of Excellence”. From its leafy Dahlem campus it offers a wide range of bachelor’s programmes in humanities, social sciences, law, economics, natural sciences and mathematics, with particular strength in political science, area studies and history.

International applicants with a non-German school-leaving certificate first apply to uni-assist for a VPD (preliminary review), then submit the application in FU’s own portal by 15 July (restricted programmes) or 1 September (unrestricted). There are no tuition fees, only a semester contribution, but you need C1 German by enrolment.
freie-universitat-berlin.tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor’s programmes are taught in German: enrolment requires C1-level German (DSH-2, TestDaF 4×4, telc C1 Hochschule, DSD II or Goethe C2). Applicants whose school diploma does not give direct access must first complete a Studienkolleg (B2 German to apply).
freie-universitat-berlin.aid_intl: No tuition; international students can apply for DAAD and foundation scholarships (e.g. Deutschlandstipendium after enrolment).
freie-universitat-berlin.gpa_note: School-leaving certificate recognised as equivalent to the German Abitur (otherwise Studienkolleg first); restricted programmes select by grade average.

university-of-zurich.about:
The University of Zurich is Switzerland’s largest university, sharing the city with ETH Zurich. It covers law, economics, medicine, veterinary medicine, sciences and humanities, and its research in life sciences, economics and medicine is internationally prominent.

International applicants must hold a school certificate that meets Swiss subject requirements and show C1 German for German-taught programmes. Applications are made online; visa-required applicants must apply by the end of February. Tuition is only about CHF 1,220 per semester for foreign bachelor’s students, but Zurich’s living costs are high.
university-of-zurich.tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor’s programmes are mainly taught in German: C1 German proof required (TestDaF, DSH, Goethe C1/C2, etc.). Foreign school certificates must meet Swiss subject requirements (first language, foreign language, maths, sciences, humanities); otherwise an entrance exam may be required.
university-of-zurich.aid_intl: Very low tuition; limited need-based support for students in financial difficulty. No dedicated bachelor’s scholarships for international applicants.

university-college-dublin.about:
University College Dublin is Ireland’s largest university, based on the Belfield campus in south Dublin. It is known for business (Quinn School / Smurfit), engineering, computer science, medicine, veterinary medicine, agriculture and law, and offers a Liberal Arts and Sciences pathway and an International Foundation Year.

Students with non-EU fee status apply directly online from 1 October, with country-specific entry requirements (for US students, a 3.2 unweighted GPA, with SAT/ACT/AP considered). English minimums are IELTS 6.5 or equivalent. Dublin is one of Europe’s tech hubs, which helps with internships.

tohoku-university.about:
Founded in 1907, Tohoku University was one of Japan's original imperial universities and is internationally known for materials science, metals research, physics and engineering. Its Gateway College offers English-taught undergraduate courses with April and October entry, alongside its larger Japanese-taught faculties.

International applicants to English-taught courses go through a comprehensive selection based on documents; those aiming for Japanese-taught programmes take the EJU and the university's own exam. Fees are the standard national rate, far below most Western universities, and hardship-based fee waivers exist.
tohoku-university.tests: English-taught courses (Gateway College): comprehensive document-based selection. Japanese-taught programmes: EJU subjects set by each faculty, TOEFL iBT 79+, and the faculty's own exam or interview in Japanese.
tohoku-university.aid_intl: Tuition and admission fee exemptions for students in financial difficulty; scholarship information for Gateway College courses via the Financial Aid page.

queen-mary-university-of-london.about:
Queen Mary University of London is a Russell Group university with one of London’s few self-contained residential campuses at Mile End, plus medical and dental schools (Barts and The London) in Whitechapel. It is known for law, economics, medicine, dentistry, engineering and the humanities, and has a very diverse student body.

Apply through UCAS. Offers are course-specific, for example Economics BSc asks AAA including Maths or IB 36 with 6,6,6 at Higher Level. International fees vary by course and include optional year-abroad and industry variants.
queen-mary-university-of-london.tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English requirements are set per course on Queen Mary’s English language entry requirements page; pre-sessional English is available.
queen-mary-university-of-london.aid_intl: Scholarships for international students include fee reductions, plus means-tested and subject-specific funding; Queen Mary says around half of undergraduates receive a scholarship or bursary.
queen-mary-university-of-london.gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. Economics BSc: AAA incl. Maths, or IB 36 with 6,6,6 at HL.

rwth-aachen-university.about:
RWTH Aachen is Germany’s largest university of technology and a member of the TU9 group, with close ties to industry in mechanical, electrical, automotive and production engineering. It sits in Aachen on the borders of Belgium and the Netherlands.

Bachelor’s programmes are taught in German, so international applicants need C1-level German and a school certificate that qualifies for direct university admission (or a Studienkolleg). There are no tuition fees, only a semester contribution. Restricted programmes close on 15 July for the winter semester.
rwth-aachen-university.tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor’s programmes are taught in German: proof of German (DSH-2, TestDaF 4×4 or equivalent C1) required. Foreign school certificates must give direct university access in Germany; otherwise a Studienkolleg is needed first.
rwth-aachen-university.aid_intl: No tuition. Scholarships such as the Deutschlandstipendium and DAAD programmes are available after enrolment.

technical-university-of-denmark.about:
DTU is a technical university on a large campus in Kongens Lyngby, north of Copenhagen, with strong research in energy, biotechnology, space, and computing. Most of its bachelor’s engineering degrees are taught in Danish; international students apply to the English-taught BSc in General Engineering, which combines a broad science and engineering foundation with later specialisation.

Applications go through Denmark’s national portal under quota 2 by 15 March, with a personal statement and proof of maths, physics, chemistry and English levels. Non-EU students pay €7,500 per semester, and DTU offers no undergraduate scholarships.

technical-university-of-denmark.aid_intl: DTU offers no scholarships or tuition fee waivers at undergraduate level.

karlsruhe-institute-of-technology.about:
KIT merges the University of Karlsruhe with a national Helmholtz research centre, making it one of Europe’s largest science and engineering institutions. It is especially strong in mechanical, electrical and chemical engineering, informatics and physics. Its English-taught Mechanical Engineering (International) B.Sc. (125 places) is run with the Carl Benz School and adds German courses and orientation support.

For that programme you upload four documents online by 30 April: your school-leaving certificate, an aptitude test (SAT 1200+, ACT 24+ or TestAS 75%+), a motivation letter and an English certificate. German-taught programmes such as Informatics close on 15 July and require C1 German. Non-EU students pay €1,500 per semester.

German-taught programmes need C1 German (DSH-2/TestDaF). APS certificate required for some countries.
karlsruhe-institute-of-technology.aid_intl: Few undergraduate scholarships; Deutschlandstipendium and DAAD options after enrolment. Exemptions from the €1,500 fee exist for some groups.

sapienza-university-of-rome.about:
Sapienza is Rome’s historic public university, founded in 1303, with a huge range of programmes across humanities, sciences, engineering, medicine and architecture. It is especially strong in classics, archaeology, physics and engineering, and offers 8 bachelor’s and about 45 master’s programmes taught entirely in English.

International students apply for English-taught degrees through an online pre-selection (€30 per application) months before the official calls, then complete visa pre-enrolment on Universitaly. Tuition is low: €300–1,500 a year depending on your country of residence.
sapienza-university-of-rome.tests: No SAT/ACT. High-school diploma after at least 12 years of schooling; English proficiency for English-taught programmes; non-EU visa applicants to Italian-taught programmes need certified Italian B2.

Southampton is a research-intensive Russell Group university with its main Highfield campus in the port city of Southampton and the National Oceanography Centre on the waterfront. Its School of Electronics and Computer Science, aeronautical and ship-science engineering, and ocean and earth sciences have strong international reputations.

Apply through UCAS. Offers are set by course, for example Computer Science BSc asks AAB including an A in maths, or IB 34 (17 at HL) with 6 in HL Mathematics. International fees for 2027/28 range from roughly £28,300 to £33,900 a year, and placement or study-abroad years are charged at a reduced rate.

university-of-waterloo.about:
Waterloo's co-operative education model lets students complete up to two years of paid work terms with employers such as Google, Microsoft and Shopify before graduating. Its Faculty of Mathematics (home of the David R. Cheriton School of Computer Science) and Faculty of Engineering are among the most competitive programmes in Canada.

International students apply through the OUAC 105 form, then complete Waterloo's Admission Information Form; Engineering applicants also take an online interview. Admission is based mainly on grades in prerequisite courses, with many programmes requiring averages in the 90s.

utrecht-university.about:
Utrecht University, founded in 1636, is a broad research university in a historic canal city 30 minutes from Amsterdam. Its English-taught bachelor’s options include University College Utrecht (a residential liberal arts college), Philosophy, Politics and Economics, Global Sustainability Science and several others, and it is especially strong in geosciences, veterinary medicine, psychology and sustainability.

You start in Studielink, then upload documents and pay the €100 fee in Utrecht’s own system. Selective programmes close on 15 January. Non-EU students pay institutional fees from €15,100 to €29,400 a year for 2027/28, depending on the programme.

university-of-st-andrews.about:
St Andrews is a small, historic university in a coastal town in Fife, known for international relations, economics, physics, classics and a strong residential community. Degrees follow the flexible four-year Scottish model, and the International Honours programme lets students split their degree with William & Mary in the USA.

You can apply through UCAS, the Common App or directly. Standard offers are high: Economics asks AAA at A-level or IB 38 (6,6,6 HL), with minimum entry grades of ABB / IB 36 for widening-access applicants. Overseas fees were £33,250 for 2026 entrants and rise each year.

rice-university.about:
Rice has about 4,500 undergraduates split among 11 residential colleges, a low student-faculty ratio and easy access to research next to the Texas Medical Center, the largest medical complex in the world. Engineering, computer science, the natural sciences, architecture and the Shepherd School of Music are standouts.

university-of-helsinki.about:
The University of Helsinki is a multidisciplinary research university in the centre of Finland’s capital. Most bachelor’s degrees are in Finnish or Swedish, but two interdisciplinary programmes are taught in English: Liberal Arts and Sciences, which mixes natural sciences, social sciences and humanities, and Science, which lets you explore physics, chemistry, maths, computer science and geosciences before specialising.

Applicants with most international diplomas apply 5–19 January and are ranked on SAT or ACT results; IB and EB holders apply in March on their grades. Non-EU students pay €13,000 a year, and top applicants can receive tuition waivers.

university-of-bath.about:
The University of Bath is a compact, highly ranked campus university known for its year-long industry placements, which many degrees include. It is strong in economics, management, engineering, architecture, computer science and sport, and its Claverton Down campus overlooks the Georgian city of Bath.

Apply through UCAS. Offers are high: Economics asks A*AA including Maths (contextual AAB) or IB 36 with 7,6,6 at HL including Maths. Overseas students can win an £8,000-a-year International Excellence Scholarship after receiving an offer.

aalto-university.about:
Aalto University was created in 2010 by merging Helsinki’s technology, business and art schools, and its Otaniemi campus in Espoo is a startup hotspot. It offers six English-taught bachelor’s programmes, including Science and Technology, Economics, Finance, International Business, Technology-Business-Design and Design and Media, and graduates get an automatic right to continue to selected master’s programmes.

You apply on Studyinfo during 7–22 January. Most international applicants are admitted on SAT/ACT scores, with clear minimums; IB and EB holders compete on their diploma grades. Non-EU students pay €12,000–15,000 a year, but strong applicants can win full tuition waivers.
aalto-university.tests: Applicants with a regular high-school diploma apply in round A on SAT or ACT (tests from 1 Jan 2025): Economics, Finance and International Business need SAT 1200+ or ACT 25+; Science & Technology and Technology-Business-Design need SAT 1350+ (Math 700+) or ACT 29+ (Math 30+). IB/EB holders are assessed on certificate grades (round B). No separate English test required for round A.
aalto-university.aid_intl: Aalto University Excellence Scholarships: competitive full tuition waivers for the top applicants (living costs not covered, at least €800/month); first-year discounts for some new students.
aalto-university.gpa_note: Round A minimums: SAT 1200 / ACT 25 (business fields) or SAT 1350 with Math 700 / ACT 29 with Math 30 (science & technology). IB/EB: certificate-based selection.

aarhus-university.about:
Aarhus University is a large research university in Denmark’s second city, with strong economics and business (Aarhus BSS), computer science, natural sciences and health. Its English-taught bachelor’s programmes include Economics and Business Administration (Aarhus and Herning), Computer Science, Data Science and IT Product Development; Cognitive Science is expected to switch to Danish in 2027.

All international applicants apply on Denmark’s national portal by 15 March. Non-EU students pay tuition per programme plus a €150 application fee, and the university offers no bachelor’s scholarships.
aarhus-university.tests: No SAT/ACT. English B-level equivalent: IELTS Academic 6.5 or TOEFL iBT (new scale 4.5 with 4.5 in each section); some programmes require English A level (IELTS 7.0, 6.0 per section). Programme-specific maths/subject requirements apply.
aarhus-university.aid_intl: Aarhus University does not offer scholarships for any of its bachelor’s programmes.
aarhus-university.gpa_note: Upper-secondary diploma meeting Danish entry requirements plus programme-specific subjects; quota 2 assessment for many international applicants.

university-of-wisconsin-madison.about:
UW-Madison is one of the original public research universities in the US, with more than 200 majors and a famously lively campus between Lake Mendota and Lake Monona. It is particularly strong in engineering, computer sciences, biochemistry, economics and journalism.

International applicants apply through the Common App and must send official secondary school records (including exam results such as IB, A-Levels or national exams) and English test scores. Tuition is charged at the non-resident rate plus an international student fee.
university-of-wisconsin-madison.tests: SAT/ACT optional through spring 2028. English (if educated in a non-English-speaking country): Duolingo 115+, IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 80 (test before 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 (new scale).
university-of-wisconsin-madison.aid_intl: Very limited for international undergraduates (not eligible for federal aid); some departmental scholarships may be available after enrolment.

university-of-exeter.about:
The University of Exeter is a Russell Group university with its main Streatham Campus in Exeter and a second campus in Cornwall focused on environment and sustainability. It is known for business, economics, politics, law, psychology and environmental and climate science.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks A*AA–AAB at A-level (with maths) or IB 36–38. International fees are relatively moderate, and Exeter Excellence Scholarships of £15,000 a year (150 awards for 2027 entry) are open to offer holders who apply early.
university-of-exeter.tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: profile-based (e.g. Economics Profile B1); see Exeter’s English language requirements for IELTS/TOEFL equivalents.
university-of-exeter.aid_intl: Exeter Excellence Scholarships (2027/28): 150 undergraduate awards of £15,000 per year off international tuition for outstanding students; apply after receiving an offer, as early as possible. Some departments offer partial scholarships.
university-of-exeter.gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. BSc Economics: A*AA–AAB with A-level Maths (grade B+), or IB 38/766–36/666 with HL5/SL6 Maths.

uc-davis.about:
UC Davis is one of the largest UC campuses, with colleges of agricultural and environmental sciences, biological sciences, engineering, and letters and science. It is globally known for agriculture, plant and animal science, food science and wine-making (viticulture and enology), and for its veterinary school.

For fall 2026 UC Davis received 104,864 first-year applications and admitted 45.8% (UC admit data). International students pay UC nonresident tuition and receive little institutional aid.
uc-davis.tests: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.
uc-davis.aid_intl: International students are not eligible for US federal or California state need-based aid. Campus scholarships for international first-years are very limited; plan to fund the full cost.

university-of-liverpool.about:
The University of Liverpool is one of the original red-brick universities, with a city-centre campus and long-standing strengths in medicine, veterinary science, life sciences, engineering, architecture and law. It co-founded Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool University in China.

Apply through UCAS. Offers are course-specific, for example Economics BSc asks AAB including A in Maths, or IB 34 with 6 in HL Maths. International fees are moderate for a Russell Group university (£28,000 for Economics in 2027/28).
university-of-liverpool.tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English (e.g. Economics): IELTS 6.5 with no component below 5.5, TOEFL iBT 88 (pre-2026) or 4.5 (new scale), Duolingo 125, PTE 61.
university-of-liverpool.aid_intl: Some international undergraduate awards (competitive or automatic, some limited by country or subject), including awards for students progressing from the University of Liverpool International College.

georgia-tech.about:
Georgia Tech's College of Engineering is one of the largest and highest-ranked in the US, and its College of Computing is equally strong. Students can join a large co-op and internship programme with Atlanta's companies.

The international first-year application fee is USD 85. Reviewers look closely at course rigour (e.g. mostly 6s and 7s for IB students), essays and English communication; Georgia Tech encourages an unscripted interview via InitialView or Vericant in addition to the required English test.
georgia-tech.tests: All international applicants must meet the University System of Georgia English requirement, e.g. TOEFL iBT 4.0 / 79 (pre-2026), IELTS Academic 6.5 recommended (6.0 minimum); Duolingo and an unscripted interview (InitialView/Vericant) are encouraged as extra evidence. SAT/ACT: see Georgia Tech's application review page.
georgia-tech.aid_intl: Very limited for international students (not eligible for federal or Georgia state aid); a few merit scholarships exist. Plan to fund the full non-resident cost.

newcastle-university.about:
Newcastle University is a Russell Group university with a city-centre campus in Newcastle upon Tyne. It has a long-established medical school and is strong in architecture, engineering, computing, business and agriculture, with campuses also in Malaysia and Singapore.

Apply through UCAS by 13 January to be automatically considered for the Vice-Chancellor’s International Scholarship worth £7,000 a year. International fees are lower than many Russell Group peers (Economics BSc £25,750 a year).
newcastle-university.tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: typically IELTS 6.5 (5.5 in each skill), TOEFL iBT 90 (pre-2026) or 4.5 on the new scale, Duolingo 125 (no sub-skill below 100); some courses higher.
newcastle-university.aid_intl: Vice-Chancellor’s International Scholarship (2027 entry): £7,000 per year off tuition for the whole course for international-fee students from eligible countries/regions (incl. all EU states), considered automatically if you apply via UCAS by 13 Jan 2027 and firm/insure Newcastle by 3 May 2027. Also VC Excellence Scholarships and family discounts.

eindhoven-university-of-technology.about:
TU/e is a compact, campus-based technical university in Eindhoven, next to high-tech companies such as ASML and Philips. Its Bachelor College combines a major with electives and design projects across mechanical, electrical and chemical engineering, computer science, applied physics, industrial design and biomedical engineering.

You register in Studielink and complete the application in TU/e’s portal. Selective programmes close on 15 January and others on 1 May. Non-EU tuition rises to €22,400 for 2027/28, and there are no TU/e bachelor’s scholarships.
eindhoven-university-of-technology.tests: No SAT/ACT. Admission requirements (English level and mathematics) depend on your country and diploma; use TU/e’s admission wizard. Some programmes have selection.
eindhoven-university-of-technology.aid_intl: No dedicated TU/e scholarships for bachelor’s students (TU/e scholarships target master’s programmes).
eindhoven-university-of-technology.gpa_note: Diploma equivalent to Dutch VWO with required mathematics (and physics for many programmes).

university-of-southern-california.about:
USC's School of Cinematic Arts is one of the best-known film schools in the world, and the Marshall School of Business, Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism and Viterbi School of Engineering are all highly ranked. Students come from nearly 130 countries.

Applying by 1 November (Early Decision or Early Action) is needed for most majors to be considered for merit scholarships. USC gives no need-based aid to international students, and all international applicants must submit an approved English exam with no exceptions.
university-of-southern-california.tests: Test-optional for 2027-28 entry. English test required for all non-native speakers (no waivers): TOEFL 100 with 20+ per section (pre-21 Jan 2026) or 5 with 4+ per section (new), IELTS 7, Cambridge C1 Advanced 185, PTE 68, SAT EBRW 650 or ACT English 27. Duolingo is not on USC's list of approved exams.
university-of-southern-california.aid_intl: No need-based aid for international applicants; all must document ability to pay the full cost at application. Internationals who apply by the early deadline are eligible for USC Merit Scholarships (a few thousand dollars up to full tuition).

wageningen-university-and-research.about:
Wageningen University & Research specialises in life sciences: food, agriculture, environment, nutrition, biotechnology and sustainable land and water use, and it regularly tops global subject rankings in agriculture. About 14,000 students from around 120 nationalities study on its green campus in Wageningen.

WUR offers 8 English-taught bachelor’s programmes. Non-EU applicants register in Studielink by 15 April and complete their file by 1 May; non-EU tuition is €18,840 for 2027/28.
wageningen-university-and-research.tests: No SAT/ACT. English and subject requirements (often maths, chemistry or biology) are set per programme on WUR’s admission requirement pages.
wageningen-university-and-research.aid_intl: WUR’s scholarships are aimed at master’s students; little dedicated funding for international bachelor’s students.

university-of-groningen.about:
The University of Groningen is a comprehensive research university founded in 1614 in the northern Dutch city of Groningen, where students make up a large part of the population. It offers 34 English-taught bachelor’s programmes, from International Business, Psychology and Econometrics to Artificial Intelligence, International Relations, law and a liberal arts college (University College Groningen), plus programmes at Campus Fryslân.

Apply via Studielink. Numerus fixus programmes such as International Business and Psychology close on 15 January, and regular programmes on 1 May.
university-of-groningen.tests: No SAT/ACT. English test results and subject requirements (e.g. maths) are set in the bachelor’s application documents and programme pages.
university-of-groningen.aid_intl: Limited bachelor’s scholarships for non-EU students; check programme pages and the university scholarship overview.

university-of-york.about:
The University of York is a Russell Group university with a collegiate system on a parkland campus just outside the medieval city of York. It is well known for economics, politics, history, English, computer science and environment, and for small-group teaching.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks AAB (Maths preferred) or IB 35 with HL5/SL7 Maths, and IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 per component. Overseas-fee offer holders from many countries automatically receive a £5,000-a-year York International Undergraduate Scholarship.
university-of-york.tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English (e.g. Economics): IELTS Academic 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each component; other tests via York’s IELTS equivalences.
university-of-york.aid_intl: York International Undergraduate Scholarship (2027/28): £5,000 per year of study, automatic for eligible overseas-fee offer holders from listed countries (incl. USA, Türkiye, many European countries) with an offer by 1 Jul 2027; also International Undergraduate Achievement Scholarship.

universite-de-montreal.about:
The Université de Montréal and its affiliated schools (Polytechnique Montréal and HEC Montréal) form one of the largest university complexes in Canada. It is especially known for medicine, law, pharmacy, psychology and AI research through Mila, founded by Yoshua Bengio.

All teaching is in French. Applications are made directly to UdeM; the application fee is CAD 83.40 per term of admission plus a per-programme fee. The exemption scholarship value depends on academic excellence as shown in the transcripts submitted with the application.

washington-university-in-st-louis.about:
WashU combines a mid-sized undergraduate body with a world-class medical school, making it a magnet for pre-med and life-science students. Undergraduates apply to one of five schools: Arts & Sciences, Olin Business School, McKelvey School of Engineering, Sam Fox School of Design & Visual Arts, or the new interdisciplinary programmes.

The application includes optional video and portfolio elements. International students from non-US schools can choose which standardised results to present (SAT/ACT, IB, A-Levels or national exams), and must show English proficiency if English is not their first language.
washington-university-in-st-louis.tests: Students from schools outside the US may submit SAT, ACT, or predicted/actual national exam, IB or A-Level results. English required if English is not your first language: competitive applicants have TOEFL 100+ (pre-21 Jan 2026) or 5.0+ (new), IELTS 7.0+, or Duolingo 130+.
washington-university-in-st-louis.aid_intl: Need-based aid and merit scholarships are offered; check WashU's cost & aid pages for international eligibility and whether need affects admission.

lancaster-university.about:
Lancaster University is a campus university near the historic city of Lancaster and the Lake District, organised into colleges that give students a smaller community. Lancaster University Management School is highly regarded, and the university is also strong in economics, accounting and finance, physics, linguistics and environmental science.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks AAB with Maths or IB 35 (16 at HL incl. 6 in HL Maths); the standard English requirement is IELTS 6.5 with 5.5 in each element.
lancaster-university.tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: IELTS Academic 6.5 with at least 5.5 in each element; TOEFL iBT 87 (pre-2026) or 4.5 overall with 4 in each element (from 21 Jan 2026). Some science, maths and medicine courses differ.

uc-santa-barbara.about:
UCSB sits on a beachfront campus near the city of Santa Barbara and combines a relaxed setting with serious research: it has several Nobel laureates on its faculty and is especially strong in physics, materials, chemical engineering, environmental science and marine biology. The College of Creative Studies offers a small, research-focused option for very motivated students.

For fall 2026 UCSB received 108,512 first-year applications and admitted 44.0% (UC admit data). International students pay UC nonresident tuition and receive little institutional aid.

uc-santa-barbara.aid_intl: International students are not eligible for US federal or California state need-based aid. Campus scholarships for international first-years are very limited; plan to fund the full cost.

mcmaster-university.about:
McMaster, in Hamilton about an hour from Toronto, is best known for health and medical research and for its Bachelor of Health Sciences (Honours), one of the most competitive undergraduate programmes in Canada. Engineering, kinesiology, nursing and the DeGroote School of Business are also popular.

International students apply through the OUAC 105 form; several programmes require a supplementary application. Students who meet the academic bar but fall short on English can receive offers conditional on McMaster's MELD or STEP programmes.

Conditional offers with MELD/STEP English programmes possible.

queens-university.about:
Queen's is a mid-sized, mostly residential university where most first-year students live on campus. Its Commerce programme at the Smith School of Business, its engineering faculty and Health Sciences are highly sought after, and Queen's also has the Bader College campus at Herstmonceux Castle in England for a first-year abroad.

International applicants use OUAC's 105 form. Commerce, Health Sciences and Nursing have earlier deadlines and mandatory supplementary applications; to compete for the large Major Admission Awards, apply early so you can access the award application on SOLUS.

michigan-state-university.about:
MSU is a land-grant university with 200+ programmes, a huge residential campus in East Lansing and the Facility for Rare Isotope Beams, a major US nuclear physics laboratory. Its Broad College of Business is well known for supply chain management, and it has strong programmes in agriculture, education, communication and hospitality.

Admission has no fixed minimums. Applying Early Action by 1 November guarantees a decision by 15 January and maximum consideration for international scholarships; after that, applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until 1 April.
michigan-state-university.tests: Test-optional: SAT/ACT not required for admission or scholarships. English for regular admission: TOEFL iBT 79 (no subscore below 17) before 21 Jan 2026, or 4 (no section below 4, 3.5 speaking) after; IELTS 6.5; Duolingo 110. Lower scores may qualify for provisional admission with English study.
michigan-state-university.aid_intl: No need-based aid for international students, but MSU awards several merit scholarships to incoming first-years with non-US residency; the admission application is usually all that is needed, and applying by 1 Nov gives maximum consideration.
requirements: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
SAT/ACT scores (optional: test-optional policy)
English test: TOEFL 79 (old) / 4 (new), IELTS 6.5 or Duolingo 110
Personal essay (Common App or MSU application)
Recommendation letter(s) where requested by the programme
Application fee (see MSU website)
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

emory-university.about:
Emory College of Arts and Sciences and Oxford College form two entry points: Oxford students spend two years on a small liberal-arts campus before continuing at Emory in Atlanta. Students can later enter the Goizueta Business School or the Nell Hodgson Woodruff School of Nursing, and Emory's Rollins School of Public Health and the CDC next door make health fields especially strong.

Emory is test-optional. International students who need aid can apply, but need-based aid goes to a select group each year, so asking for aid may affect chances. The Emory University Scholar Programs offer merit awards up to the full cost of attendance.
emory-university.tests: Test-optional for the 2026-27 cycle. English: no strict cutoffs, but recommended TOEFL iBT 100 (or 5.5 on the new scale), IELTS 7.5, or Duolingo; SAT EBRW 700+ or ACT English 30+ can also show proficiency. Optional InitialView interview.
emory-university.aid_intl: Emory offers need-based financial aid to a select group of international students each year (aid applicants still submit financial documentation). Merit awards through the Emory University Scholar Programs are open to all applicants.
requirements: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
SAT/ACT scores (optional: test-optional policy)
English test: recommended: TOEFL 100 / 5.5, IELTS 7.5, or Duolingo
Common App personal essay (up to 650 words)
Emory supplemental questions
School counselor report + 2 teacher recommendations
Optional InitialView interview
Application fee (see Emory website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Financial aid forms if requesting aid (CSS Profile and/or the university's international aid form)

ohio-state-university.about:
Ohio State is a public land-grant university with very broad offerings, from the Fisher College of Business and a large College of Engineering to agriculture, medicine, communication and the arts. The Columbus campus is one of the biggest in the US, with a huge student community and big-time college sports.

International first-year applicants must submit ACT or SAT scores, proof of English and transcripts. Half of admitted students scored between 1280 and 1470 on the SAT.
ohio-state-university.tests: ACT or SAT required for first-year applicants to the Columbus campus (superscored). English: TOEFL 79+ (before 21 Jan 2026) or 4.0+ (new), IELTS 6.5+, Duolingo 120+, ACT English 21+ or SAT EBRW 550+.
ohio-state-university.aid_intl: Limited: international students are not eligible for federal aid; Ohio State offers merit-based scholarships for which some international students may qualify.
ohio-state-university.gpa_note: 50% of admitted students scored ACT 27-33 / SAT 1280-1470 ('Who gets in' page).

SAT or ACT scores (required)
English test: TOEFL 79 / 4.0, IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 120
Common App personal essay (up to 650 words)
Ohio State application questions

hong-kong-baptist-university.about:
HKBU describes itself as one of Asia's leading liberal-arts universities, with English-medium teaching, low staff-to-student ratios and a close community. It is known for its Academy of Film, School of Communication, Academy of Visual Arts and School of Chinese Medicine, plus business and science programmes.

Applications received in the Early Round are assessed first, with offers from late December; others are considered with the Main Round. The admission scholarships need no separate application, and the university offers overseas internships, exchange and entrepreneurship bootcamps.
hong-kong-baptist-university.tests: SAT minimum 1190 (new SAT) for US-pattern applicants; AP grade 3 in two subjects. English: TOEFL iBT 79 or IELTS Academic 6.0 (from 2027 entry the test must be taken on or after 1 Sept 2025), or SAT EBRW 590.
hong-kong-baptist-university.aid_intl: Admission scholarships are awarded on academic and non-academic merit with no separate application.

united-arab-emirates-university.about:
Founded in 1976, UAEU is the country's flagship federal research university, with nine colleges including engineering, medicine and health sciences, IT, science, business and economics, law, education, humanities and social sciences, and agriculture and veterinary medicine. Most programmes are taught in English and the university runs separate male and female campus facilities in Al Ain.

International students and children of UAEU employees apply online during announced admission periods with a Grade 12 certificate (plus MOE equivalency for foreign curricula) and an English test. Places for non-nationals are limited, so very strong grades matter; the Chancellor's scholarships reward 95-98%+ averages or exceptional talent.
united-arab-emirates-university.tests: International applicants: Grade 12 average of 90% (health sciences, engineering, computing/AI, science, agriculture/veterinary) or 85% (business, humanities, education, law); English 90% in MOE Grade 12 English, or IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL iBT 70 or TOEFL ITP 525. Applicants must be 35 or younger. The MD programme is limited to nationals and funded students.
united-arab-emirates-university.aid_intl: Chancellor's Scholarship for Elite Students (100% tuition with 98%+ in Grade 12, 75% with 95%+, plus English and maths scores) and Chancellor's Scholarship for Talented Students (100% or 50% for innovation, arts, sport or technology). Tuition only; housing not covered.
united-arab-emirates-university.gpa_note: International applicants need a 90% (STEM and health) or 85% (other colleges) high-school average.

uc-irvine.about:
UC Irvine's Donald Bren School of Information and Computer Sciences is one of the few stand-alone computing schools in the US, and the campus is also known for biological sciences, nursing, public health and criminology. Southern California's tech and biotech companies are close by.

For fall 2026 UC Irvine received 126,005 first-year applications and admitted 30.3% (UC admit data). International students pay UC nonresident tuition and receive little institutional aid.
uc-irvine.tests: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.
uc-irvine.aid_intl: International students are not eligible for US federal or California state need-based aid. Campus scholarships for international first-years are very limited; plan to fund the full cost.
requirements: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
No SAT/ACT needed (scores not considered)

UC Personal Insight Questions (answer 4 of 8, up to 350 words each)

ajman-university.about:
Founded in 1988, Ajman University has around ten colleges, from medicine, dentistry and pharmacy to engineering, IT, business, law and mass communication, on a campus in the northern emirates. It is popular with Gulf and Arab students and also enrols students from across Asia and Africa.

Admission is based on high-school results with subject minimums per programme and an English test for English-taught degrees. Fees are listed per programme on the undergraduate tuition page for 2026-27, and the scholarship office offers merit and family discounts.
ajman-university.tests: English-taught programmes: 80% in Grade 12 English, or IELTS Academic 5.0 / TOEFL iBT 61 (ITP 500). Doctor of Medicine: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 79. Subject minimums: 90% in maths and two sciences for medicine and dentistry; 80% for engineering and pharmacy; 70-75% maths for IT, AI, law and IS.
ajman-university.aid_intl: Scholarships and discounts are handled by the Office of Scholarship & Financial Aid (academic merit, siblings, sports and others).

uc-riverside.about:
UC Riverside is a diverse research campus about an hour east of Los Angeles, with the UC's historic Citrus Experiment Station, a School of Business and a growing engineering college. It gives a UC degree with a much higher admit rate than the coastal campuses.

For fall 2026 UC Riverside received 72,542 first-year applications and admitted 88.2% (UC admit data). International students pay UC nonresident tuition; UCR automatically considers them for its Achievement Scholarship for Nonresident Students.
uc-riverside.tests: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.
uc-riverside.aid_intl: International students are automatically considered for UCR's Achievement Scholarship for Nonresident Students (renewable while keeping a 3.0 GPA). No federal or state need-based aid for internationals.

uc-santa-cruz.about:
UC Santa Cruz is organised into ten residential colleges on a forested hillside campus overlooking the ocean. It runs the UC's Lick Observatory, is a leader in genomics, and its computational media and game design programmes are well regarded; Silicon Valley is about 45 minutes away.

For fall 2026 UC Santa Cruz received 79,048 first-year applications and admitted 82.1% (UC admit data). International students pay UC nonresident tuition and receive little institutional aid.
uc-santa-cruz.tests: Test-blind: SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission. English (if required): IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115, or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before Jan 2026) / 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale (from Jan 2026). Some majors or campuses may expect more.
uc-santa-cruz.aid_intl: International students are not eligible for US federal or California state need-based aid. Campus scholarships for international first-years are very limited; plan to fund the full cost.
uc-santa-cruz.gpa_note: Middle 50% high-school GPA of fall 2026 admits: 3.79-4.20 (UC admit data).
